```{python}
from io import StringIO

import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import plotly.io as pio
import requests

pio.renderers.default = "notebook_connected"

FRED_SERIES = {
    "IRLTLT01ITM156N": "Italy 10Y",
    "IRLTLT01DEM156N": "Germany 10Y",
}
FRED_CSV_URL = "https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=" + ",".join(
    FRED_SERIES
)

response = requests.get(FRED_CSV_URL, timeout=60)
response.raise_for_status()
df = (
    pd.read_csv(
        StringIO(response.text),
        parse_dates=["observation_date"],
        na_values=["."],
    )
    .rename(columns={"observation_date": "date", **FRED_SERIES})
    .set_index("date")
    .dropna()
)
df["Spread (bp)"] = (df["Italy 10Y"] - df["Germany 10Y"]) * 100

latest = df.iloc[-1]
latest_date = df.index[-1]
year_ago = df["Spread (bp)"].asof(latest_date - pd.DateOffset(years=1))
peak_date = df["Spread (bp)"].idxmax()
peak = df["Spread (bp)"].max()
```

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-8}

```{python}
fig = go.Figure()
fig.add_trace(
    go.Scatter(
        x=df.index,
        y=df["Spread (bp)"],
        name="BTP–Bund spread",
        mode="lines",
        line=dict(color="#a78bfa", width=2),
        fill="tozeroy",
        fillcolor="rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.12)",
        customdata=df[["Italy 10Y", "Germany 10Y"]],
        hovertemplate=(
            "<b>%{x|%b %Y}</b><br>"
            "Spread: %{y:.0f} bp<br>"
            "Italy 10Y: %{customdata[0]:.2f}%<br>"
            "Germany 10Y: %{customdata[1]:.2f}%"
            "<extra></extra>"
        ),
    )
)
fig.add_annotation(
    x=peak_date,
    y=peak,
    text=f"Peak {peak:.0f} bp<br>{peak_date:%b %Y}",
    showarrow=True,
    arrowhead=2,
    ax=40,
    ay=-30,
)
fig.update_layout(
    template="plotly_dark",
    paper_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    plot_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    font=dict(family="ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif", color="#a0a7b4"),
    height=520,
    margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10),
    yaxis_title="Spread (basis points)",
    hovermode="x",
    showlegend=False,
    yaxis=dict(gridcolor="#11161d", zerolinecolor="rgba(255,255,255,0.08)"),
    xaxis=dict(
        type="date",
        gridcolor="#11161d",
        rangeslider=dict(visible=True, bgcolor="#080d13", bordercolor="rgba(255,255,255,0.08)"),
        rangeselector=dict(
            bgcolor="#11161d",
            activecolor="#7c5cff",
            font=dict(color="#a0a7b4"),
            buttons=[
                dict(count=1, label="1Y", step="year", stepmode="backward"),
                dict(count=5, label="5Y", step="year", stepmode="backward"),
                dict(count=10, label="10Y", step="year", stepmode="backward"),
                dict(step="all", label="All"),
            ]
        ),
    ),
)
fig.show(config={"scrollZoom": True, "displaylogo": False})
```

::: {.small .text-muted}
Spread = Italy 10Y yield − Germany 10Y yield, monthly averages.
Source: OECD via FRED ([IRLTLT01ITM156N](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/IRLTLT01ITM156N),
[IRLTLT01DEM156N](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/IRLTLT01DEM156N)).
